today.description: Your hearings for the day, by court and hall.
today.empty: No hearings today. Forward a cause list to see your court day.
today.hint: When a cause list is forwarded, your hearings appear here by court and hall.

tomorrow.hint: Listings for the next court day appear here once cause lists arrive.

calendar.description: Upcoming court days at a glance.
calendar.hint: Hearings and deadlines from your matters fill in this calendar.

inbox.description: Captures that need you, are ready to send or are processing.
inbox.hint: Forwarded emails, voice notes and files that need a decision land here.

matters.empty: No matters yet. Import or add your first matter.
matters.hint: Matters are created from your cause lists, or added by hand.

briefs.empty: No briefs yet. A brief appears when a matter is listed.
briefs.hint: Each listed matter gets a one-page brief for the hearing.

obligations.description: Filings, copies and follow-ups that are due.
obligations.hint: Filings, copies and follow-ups from your hearings are tracked here.

drafts.hint: Drafts you start from a matter are kept here until they are filed.

memory.description: What CauseDeck has noted, for you to review.
memory.hint: Notes CauseDeck learns from your work wait here for your review.

people.empty: No people yet. Add a client or counsel.
people.hint: Clients and counsel are linked to the matters they appear in.

courts.empty: Choose your courts to get started.
courts.hint: Your forums decide which cause lists CauseDeck reads for you.

notices.description: Official notices for your forums and matters.
notices.hint: Notices appear when a court publishes one for a forum you use.

portfolio.hint: Create a portfolio and import a CSV of cases to start.

activity.hint: Every change in this workspace is listed here, with undo.

billing.hint: Fees and payments are tracked against each matter.

invoices.hint: Invoices you raise for a matter are listed here.

limitation.hint: Limitation periods are computed from the dates in your matters.

insights.empty: Not enough activity for insights yet.
insights.hint: Trends across your matters and court days appear here.

settings.description: Workspace profile, members, roles and privacy.
settings.empty: Pick a section in the settings list.
settings.hint: Workspace profile, members, roles and privacy settings are in the list.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.description: Something went wrong loading this page.

offline.message: You are offline. Showing saved data from {time}.

permissionDenied.title: No access
permissionDenied.message: You do not have access to this area.
permissionDenied.askOwner: Ask a workspace owner to change your role if you need this.

permission.ownersAndAdvocates: Only owners and advocates can do this

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: We could not find this page in this workspace.

supportBanner.error: Could not end the session. Try again.

ownerTwoFactor.message: Turn on two-factor authentication to keep owner access. Deleting, exporting and billing changes are blocked until you do.

demoBanner.label: Demo workspace, sample data
demoBanner.hint: Sample data only. Nothing here is real, and nothing leaves this workspace.

demoEntry.title: Explore a demo workspace
demoEntry.intro: Pick a sample workspace. Everything in it is made up, nothing is sent outside it, and your session ends after 4 hours.

demoEntry.bengaluruDescription: A chamber with a junior and a clerk: High Court of Karnataka and the city courts.
